title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**We’re hiring: Tender Executive (Government/PSU Tenders), Hapur, UP**

**Voltaire Power Systems has manufactured servo stabilizers and transformers since 1990, serving IAF, ONGC, BPCL and Indian Railways. We are building an in-house tender function and are looking for someone to own it end to end.**

**Responsibilities:**

* Prepare technical and commercial bids, compliance sheets and BoQ inputs
* Submit bids on GeM, CPPP, IREPS and PSU portals
* Manage DSCs, EMD/PBG, and vendor and portal registrations
* Track every bid through to award, with follow-ups at each stage

**Requirements:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience with government tender submission
* Experience with electrical, engineering or EPC tenders preferred
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy

**Location:**
On-site, Hapur

**Salary:**
No bar for the right candidate

Interested candidates can send their CV, with a brief note on the portals they have worked on, to admin@voltairepowersys.com, or message me directly.

#Hiring #TenderExecutive #GovernmentTenders #GeM #Hapur
